items.title: 【开源自荐】Rclaude：共享 agent 的"使用"而不是 API —— 代码留本地，agent 在远端跑
items.author: flyingEirc
items.summary: 【开源自荐】Rclaude：共享 agent 的"使用"而不是 API —— 代码留本地，agent 在远端跑 项目名称：Rclaude（flyingEirc/Rclaude） 项目简介：一套"远程文件访问 + 远程 agent 终端"系统。它不是把某个 agent 的 API 包装后转卖，而是共享 agent 的使用本身：一个已登录的编码 agent（Claude Code、Codex 等）跑在远端机器上，你在本地把工作区和终端接上去，直接驱动它——而你的代码始终留在自己机器上，不上传。 项目地址： 分类：AI Agent / 开发工具 核心亮点： 共享的是"使用"不是 API：终端直连真实 agent 二进制的完整 TUI 与 agentic loop。你共享出去的是"用这个 agent 这件事"。 代码不出本地：通过 FUSE 把本地工作区映射到远端，agent 用普通路径（cat/grep/ls/sed）读写你的项目；源文件始终在你机器上，server 只持有缓存与元数据，不保存完整副本。 daemon 主动外连：连接从你的机器发起到 server，server 无需反向拨回你的内网。 会话被收口到单一 agent：落点直接是命令行声明的 agent——整个会话离不开 agent 界面，也无法在 server 上乱逛。共享的是"这个 agent"，不是"一台 Linux"。 可选增强：前置 Caddy 终止 TLS（server 二进制保持明文 h2c）。 推荐理由：现在要么是分发 API key（拿到的是原始接口，不是 agent 的交互式使用），要么是把代码传到一台共享云机器上（代码交了出去）。Rclaude反过来：共享的是一个已登录 agent 的交互式使用，代码留在本地，适合小团队想摊薄一个订阅席位、又不愿把代码交出去的场景。Go 实现，server 端需 Linux + FUSE；目前 Codex / Claude Code/ Cursor Agent的 TUI attach 与远端执行全链路已跑通。仍是最小可用路径、非生产发行版，处于迭代中。

【开源自荐】Rclaude：共享 agent 的"使用"而不是 API —— 代码留本地，agent 在远端跑

**项目名称**：Rclaude（flyingEirc/Rclaude）

**项目简介**：一套"远程文件访问 + 远程 agent 终端"系统。它不是把某个 agent 的 API 包装后转卖，而是共享 agent 的**使用本身**：一个已登录的编码 agent（Claude Code、Codex 等）跑在远端机器上，你在本地把工作区和终端接上去，直接驱动它——而你的代码始终留在自己机器上，不上传。

**项目地址**：https://github.com/flyingEirc/Rclaude

**分类**：AI Agent / 开发工具

**核心亮点**：

- **共享的是"使用"不是 API**：终端直连真实 agent 二进制的完整 TUI 与 agentic loop。你共享出去的是"用这个 agent 这件事"。
- **代码不出本地**：通过 FUSE 把本地工作区映射到远端，agent 用普通路径（cat/grep/ls/sed）读写你的项目；源文件始终在你机器上，server 只持有缓存与元数据，不保存完整副本。
- **daemon 主动外连**：连接从你的机器发起到 server，server 无需反向拨回你的内网。
- **会话被收口到单一 agent**：落点直接是命令行声明的 agent——整个会话离不开 agent 界面，也无法在 server 上乱逛。共享的是"这个 agent"，不是"一台 Linux"。
- **可选增强**：前置 Caddy 终止 TLS（server 二进制保持明文 h2c）。

**推荐理由**：现在要么是分发 API key（拿到的是原始接口，不是 agent 的交互式使用），要么是把代码传到一台共享云机器上（代码交了出去）。Rclaude反过来：共享的是**一个已登录 agent 的交互式使用，代码留在本地**，适合小团队想摊薄一个订阅席位、又不愿把代码交出去的场景。Go 实现，server 端需 Linux + FUSE；目前 Codex  / Claude Code/ Cursor Agent的 TUI attach 与远端执行全链路已跑通。仍是最小可用路径、非生产发行版，处于迭代中。

items.content:
## 项目介绍

murPick 是一个开源 Agent Skill（MIT），解决 AI 辅助产品调研的两个真实痛点：

1. **长报告信息过载**——AI 调研动辄五千字，读到后面忘前面；
2. **决策被悄悄代做**——在无 skill 的基线测试里，AI 会在报告中直接写出"V1 = 一个骨架 + 三个模块"和"明确不做清单"，用户还没选，范围已被替定。

murPick 让 AI 把调研结果生成一份**交互式"功能点菜菜单"**（自包含单文件 HTML，手机可用）：每个候选功能一个勾选框，像点菜一样勾选，勾选状态可一键烧录进文件回传，AI 据此产出带架构图的选型报告。**未勾选项会被整理成明确的"不做"边界清单**——是"决定不做"，而不是"被遗忘"。

## 特点

- 单文件 HTML 菜单：localStorage 自动保存、勾选烧录回传、导出 JSON，无需服务器
- 用文档 TDD（RED-GREEN-REFACTOR）方式开发：仓库内附无 skill 基线的逐字失败证据、压力测试记录
- 12 项硬约束由验证脚本把关（checkbox id 唯一性、烧录逻辑、自包含性等）
- examples/ 内含一次完整回路演示（调研摘要 → 60 项菜单 → 勾选回传 → 全量回溯报告）
- 遵循开放的 Agent Skills 规范；国内可通过 Anthropic 兼容端点（GLM/Kimi/DeepSeek）低门槛使用

## 链接

- GitHub：https://github.com/ymustc/murPick
- 中文说明：https://github.com/ymustc/murPick/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md

items.title: 自荐软件:hevc.js — 236KB 的 WASM HEVC 解码器,让不支持 H.265 的浏览器也能播放
items.author: privaloops
items.summary: 项目地址: README) 在线演示: hevc.js 是一个完全从 ITUT H.265 规范(716 页)从零写起的 HEVC 解码器, C++17 实现,编译为 WebAssembly 后只有 236KB(约为 libde265 WASM 版的 1/8), MIT 协议,零依赖。 它解决的问题:Windows 上的 Chrome 没有 HEVC 软解回退(旧显卡直接放不出来), Edge/Firefox 需要微软商店的付费扩展,Linux 看运气。hevc.js 通过拦截 MediaSource,在 Web Worker 里把 HEVC 实时转码为 H.264(WASM 解码 + WebCodecs 编码),让 dash.js 和 Shaka Player 在这些环境下正常播放 HEVC 流 —— 播放器完全无感知,一行 attachHevcSupport() 接入,不需要 COOP/COEP 响应头。 几个数字:1080p 解码 60fps(单线程),转码约 2.5 倍实时,与 ffmpeg 在 128 个测试码流上逐像素比对验证。已被 dash.js 官方收录为 playback sample(5.2.1+)。 比较特别的一点:它带有"算力感知 ABR"—— 弱 CPU 上转码跟不上实时时, 自动通过播放器自己的公开配置降低码率档位,避免缓冲区被掏空(带宽型 ABR 看不到 CPU 瓶颈)。

items.title: Noosphere
items.summary: One Agent learns. Every Agent inherits the verified Skill.
items.content: AI Agents repeatedly solve the same engineering problems from scratch. Noosphere lets an Agent automatically discover the most relevant verified Skill, check its exact version and SHA-256, apply it, and verify the result. With authorization, newly tested experience can be shared for other Agents to reuse. v0.9.2 ships a focused 6-tool MCP profile by default, reducing its conservative metadata footprint by about 98%, while keeping the full 46-tool interface available. Open source. Apache 2.0.

items.title: Revonex - Business Empire Builder
items.summary: The all-in-one Shopify alternative built for Indian sellers
items.content: Revonex is an all-in-one SaaS ecommerce platform built for Indian business owners - a true Shopify alternative. Launch a multi-tenant storefront in minutes, choose from 50+ customizable templates, run your entire business with built-in tools: staff payroll, revenue tracking, and a 15-plugin ecosystem covering dropshipping, Telegram/Discord, and more. No coding needed — just pick a template, customize it, and start selling. Built for sellers who want more than a storefront: a full business OS.

items.title: CertShield
items.summary: Never work with an uninsured vendor again
items.content: CertShield reads vendor insurance certificates (COIs) with AI — extracting limits, dates, and the endorsement forms everyone misses (CG 20 10 / 20 37) — checks them against your rules, and chases vendors for renewals automatically in English + Spanish. Every uncertain result is human-reviewed before you see it. Built for US property managers and contractors who track this in spreadsheets today. Enterprise tools charge $8–25K/yr; CertShield starts at $99/mo. Free 3-COI audit, 24h turnaround.

items.title: QuantixOne
items.summary: AI-Powered CRM & Business Automation Platform
items.content: QuantixOne is an AI-powered CRM software that automates sales, marketing, and customer engagement. Best CRM system for agencies and growing businesses — start free.

items.title: Shift Calendar & Alarm
items.summary: A shift-worker's calendar that starts blank, not full
items.content: Shift Calendar & Alarm is a calendar built for people whose days off change every week. Instead of a fixed monthly grid, you start from a blank calendar and add only your shifts - the calendar builds itself around your actual schedule. Every shift can have its own alarm, including cross-midnight shifts (22:00-06:00). Alarms ring even when the app is closed. Public holidays for 10 countries, payday highlighting, and anniversaries are all built in. Free, offline, no account required.

items.title: Infragrid
items.summary: Turn your last mile work into software
items.content: Most enterprise work still happens in browsers, spreadsheets, and internal tools—and the knowledge behind those workflows lives inside SOPs and the heads of experienced operators. We built Infragrid Screen Recorder to change that. Record a workflow once, and Infragrid captures browser actions, analyst decisions, and business logic. We then compile that knowledge into deterministic, reusable workflows that can be executed reliably with AI and browser automation.

items.title: Discfront
items.summary: Turn your Discord server into a complete storefront
items.content: Discfront is a Discord payment bot for selling digital products, paid roles, subscriptions, memberships, and license keys without command-heavy checkout flows. Buyers use buttons while Discfront verifies Stripe and Bitcoin payments through BTCPay, automates role and license delivery, manages renewals, sends signed webhooks, and keeps accounting records. Payments settle directly to the seller's connected provider account or wallet. Every plan includes a 30-day free trial.

items.title: CollectFlow —AI Invoice Collection Agent
items.summary: Automate invoice collection . Stop chasing unpaid invoices.
items.content: CollectFlow is an AI-powered n8n workflow that automates invoice follow-ups. It checks overdue invoices daily, analyzes client email history, selects the right reminder tone, and creates or sends personalized Gmail reminders automatically. It also logs every action, sends daily Slack summaries, and prevents duplicate follow-ups. Perfect for freelancers, agencies, consultants, and small businesses.

items.content: AuraLook upgrades your Android lock screen notifications with a premium, cinematic experience. When your screen is off, it intercepts incoming alerts and presents them on a beautifully minimalist, pure OLED black canvas for instant glanceability. 🔋 OLED Saver: Keeps pixels off to save battery. 🧠 Smart Filtering: Syncs with DND & ignores clutter. 📱 Gestures: Tap to dismiss, swipe to open. 🛡️ Privacy-First: 100% offline, zero internet.

items.title: Heimdal by Bearlog
items.summary: Turn your device into a face recognition time clock
items.content: Heimdal turns any device with a camera and a browser into an attendance kiosk. Staff tap IN or OUT, look at the screen, and the record lands in seconds. No fingerprint terminal to buy, no ID cards to reissue, nothing to install. People enroll from their own phone with a group invite link. The kiosk runs a liveness check, converts the face to a template on the device, and sends no photo after enrollment. Attendance, monthly summaries and CSV exports are built in.

Our goal is to help students, researchers, educators, and professionals learn, organize information, and work more effectively through accessible, thoughtfully designed technology.
